message.content: On September 16th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz suggested incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. This was proposed as a way to boost jazz fusion skills and make the sessions more fun and creative. LiHua enthusiastically supported this idea, expressing excitement about the challenges it would present and the opportunity for each musician to showcase their individual talents. They agreed that improvisation would not only make the practice sessions more engaging but also help musicians grow as performers. LiHua suggested they could either pick a specific song or just go with the flow, which WolfgangSchulz found ideal for allowing the musicians to vibe off each other spontaneously. The group was looking forward to trying this new approach and making the most of their practice time together.
